resources.string: Access to this file has expired. Select it again from Import.
The file is unavailable. Download it to this device and select it again.
The file is empty or the package contains no notes. Ask for a new export.
This archive is not a Pampa Notes package. Ask for a .pn file or a ZIP exported by Pampa Notes.
The package uses a newer format version. Update Pampa Notes and try again.
The package is incomplete or damaged. Download it again or ask for a new export.
The package exceeds import limits. Ask for fewer notes per export.
There is not enough space to prepare the files. Free up space on this device and try again.
The selected folder is unavailable or cannot contain this update. Reopen the package and choose the original folders or another destination.
A transcription is using a recording that needs updating. Wait for it to finish or cancel it, then reopen the package.
The package data conflicts with an existing note. Reopen it and choose Create copies, or ask for a new export.
The package could not be imported. Reopen the file and try again; if it happens again, ask for a new export.
Restores the text, recordings and transcript versions included in this package. Timing and speakers are available only when they were present in the export.
